messages:
Lina Park: Quick design review — thinking through a compact "breadcrumbs" pattern for Deployment history + a safer revert flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (frame: history-breadcrumbs) :eyes:

Samir Patel: Nice. Question: how will keyboard users move between crumbs? tab sequence could get noisy if each crumb expands a diff panel.

Aria Gomez: Suggestion: make crumbs focusable with arrow keys (left/right) and keep tab to jump out. Screen-reader announce format: "Version 0.9.2, canary 10%, expanded". Maybe use `aria-roledescription` and `aria-live` for state changes.

Jayden Wu: Agree on arrow nav. Also worried about visual density when a bunch of variants exist (A/B test with 6 variants). Could collapse minor variants behind a "+3" stacked pill. Hover to preview.

Kevin O'Neill: Microcopy: current CTA says "Promote" for canary -> customers misread as publish. Propose "Roll forward" for stepping traffic up, and "Revert" for full revert. Short, action-y.

Lina Park: Good call on copy. Also thinking about the revert confirmation pattern: lightweight inline undo toast for 5s + a secondary modal for full revert to previous snapshot. Keeps flow fast but safe.

Samir Patel: For the inline undo, screen-reader should get a polite `aria-live` region: "Deployment reverted. Undo available." Ensure focus isn't stolen.

Aria Gomez: Proposed SR text for crumbs: `Deployment history, timeline control. Use left and right arrows to navigate versions. Press Enter for details.` Keep it concise.

Jayden Wu: Interaction nit: don't auto-open the diff on hover. Open on Enter or click only. Hover shows a lightweight summary tooltip: author, short commit msg, traffic %. Tooltip delay ~300ms.

Lina Park: Agree. Also want a small diff-summary line in each crumb: e.g., "+2 prompts, -1 param change" so PMs get context without opening panel.

Kevin O'Neill: Accessibility/color nit: status pills (canary, stable, degraded) currently use tinted backgrounds only. Need better contrast and an icon for color-blind folks. Recommend small left indicator dot + text.

ux-bot: deploy-preview updated for frame history-breadcrumbs — preview link: https://deploy.preview/redwood/history-breadcrumbs (build 673) :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: One more: keyboard shortcut to jump to latest (G then L?) maybe heavy-handed. Could add a "Go to latest" button at start of crumbs with `aria-label`.

Aria Gomez: And ensure focus order: Go-to-latest -> breadcrumb list -> Actions (Promote/Roll forward/Revert). Screen-reader should announce current selection.

Lina Park: Next steps: Jayden — add tooltip delay + collapsed variants pattern. Aria — write exact SR strings and aria attributes. Kevin — reword CTAs and add icon set for status pills. Samir — prototype arrow-key UX and tab order. I'll iterate the Figma and ping again. :thumbsup:

Jayden Wu: On it.

Aria Gomez: Will add copy by EOD.

Kevin O'Neill: I'll mock icons and update copy.

Lina Park: Thanks all — meeting if needed but let's try async.
